assertions: One exact scope, product revision, decision, purpose set, form field set, notice, submission and withdrawal mechanism are frozen together.
Only currently declared consent whose notice matches the scope and predates the submission can become ready for review.
Missing or unexpected fields, out-of-scope purposes, unresolved other-people data, identifiers, sensitive data and overlong retention are blocked.
The connector binds caller-provided privacy-review evidence but does not detect identifiers, certify de-identification or make a legal-compliance claim.
The result always requires human review and never stores data, issues a receipt, applies withdrawal, replies, writes knowledge or authorizes execution.
